detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Humanin

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C119H204N34O32S2
  • Molecular Weight: 2687.2 g/mol
  • Sequence: Met-Ala-Pro-Arg-Gly-Phe-Ser-Cys-Leu-Leu-Leu-Leu-Thr-Ser-Glu-Ile-Asp-Leu-Pro-Val-Lys-Arg-Arg-Ala
  • Structure Class: Synthetic peptide (mitochondrial-derived bioactive sequence)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Humanin is a synthetic peptide corresponding to a mitochondrial-derived sequence. It is provided in lyophilized powder form to ensure stability and purity for laboratory use. This compound is utilized in controlled in vitro research settings involving peptide stability, receptor binding, and intracellular signaling pathway analysis.

Research Applications:

Humanin is used in controlled research protocols addressing topics such as:

  • Investigation of mitochondrial-derived peptides in in vitro systems
  • Evaluation of peptide–receptor interactions and associated signaling cascades
  • Analysis of peptide behavior in cellular stress-response models under laboratory conditions
  • Structural comparison of naturally occurring versus synthetic peptide analogues
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Maintain aseptic handling during laboratory protocols
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Humanin is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
